name: todoweekend
description: What is on this weekend in 13 cities: scored plans with times, venues and a link to the city map on todoweekend.com.

interface.longDescription:
TodoWeekend shows what is on this weekend in 13 cities: Madrid, Barcelona, Lisboa, Paris, Berlin, London, Miami, Santiago de Chile, Tokyo, Mexico City, Buenos Aires, Helsinki and New York. Ask what is on this weekend, today, tomorrow or on any date, or ask for concerts, exhibitions, theatre, family plans or free events.

You get the 12 strongest plans first, scored for the weekend, each with its time, venue, price when it is known and a Highlight mark on the top picks. One tap opens the city map on todoweekend.com on the same dates and filter, with every listing on it and each event's official page one more tap away. Ask about any listing for its full description, address and official page.

Good to know: TodoWeekend covers the 13 cities above. Listings suit ages 13 and up, so nightlife and alcohol-led events are left out. Every answer says when the city's listings were last updated, and adds a notice when that is more than seven days ago. Each answer credits its sources. TodoWeekend does not sell tickets, needs no account and only reads public listings.
capabilities: Find things to do by date and category
defaultPrompt: What's on in Madrid this weekend?
Free things to do in Mexico City on Saturday.
Exhibitions in New York this weekend.

positive.description: Weekend events in a covered city
positive.prompt: Use TodoWeekend to see what's on in Madrid this weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of up to 12 Madrid events for the coming Saturday and Sunday, best first, the date the data was updated, TodoWeekend links and an Open the map button. Any out-of-date notice is repeated.

positive.description: Free events on a given day
positive.prompt: Use TodoWeekend to find free things to do in Barcelona on Saturday.
positive.expected_behavior: Barcelona events for that Saturday where every listing is marked Free.

positive.prompt: Use TodoWeekend to find exhibitions in London this weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: London events in the Exhibitions category, plus long-running exhibitions marked Until a date; the widget opens on the Exhibitions tab.
The 13 cities: Madrid, Barcelona, Lisboa, Paris, Berlin, London, Miami, Santiago, Tokyo, Mexico City, Buenos Aires, Helsinki, New York, with country and timezone.

positive.prompt: Use TodoWeekend to find a concert in Berlin this weekend, then give me the full details of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: A short Berlin concert list, then the description, venue, address, price, map point, TodoWeekend page and official page link for the first event.

negative.prompt: Buy two tickets for the Teatro Real show on Saturday.
What is on in Sydney this weekend?
What will the weather be like in Paris on Sunday?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It links to event pages and to sellers' own ticket pages.

publication.release_notes: Four new cities (Mexico City, Buenos Aires, Helsinki, New York), the widget redrawn in the todoweekend.com look with an Open the map button, and source credits for the new open-data feeds. Same three read-only tools.
